Mat’s flown over to Utah to get his hands on the Audi SQ9! 

It’s the first generation of the Audi Q9 & SQ9, and it sits right at the top of the Audi range. What’s more, it’s also the largest Audi ever produced! 

So with that in mind, should you choose it over class-leading 7-seaters like the BMW X7 and Mercedes GLS? Let’s take a closer look, starting with the design… 

From the outside, there’s no denying the all-new Q9 is a super large & imposing beast. Up front, there are similarities between the entry-level Q9 and this SQ9, although the latter has a more aggressive look to it, thanks to a different bumper and grille design. The large grille is flanked on either side by Audi’s class-leading DRLs, and the main headlights sit in a separate unit on the front end.
